title: Guidance: CFG and what it really does

options: The unscaled difference of the two predictions

questions.q: Ho and Salimans' w = 6.5 corresponds to which ComfyUI cfg?
questions.why: They write (1+w)ε_c − wε_u, so cfg = w + 1.

questions.q: Does sampling with CFG draw from p(x) p(c|x)^cfg?
options: Yes, when the schedule is Karras
No, in general the guided field is not the score of that density's noised versions
questions.answer: No, in general the guided field is not the score of that density's noised versions
questions.why: Stated by Ho and Salimans, Bradley and Nakkiran, and Chidambaram et al. The lab's samples at 7.5 sit a full unit past the tilted mean.

questions.q: What does cfg = 1 do to the cost per step?
options: One model call, because the unconditional run is skipped
questions.answer: One model call, because the unconditional run is skipped
questions.why: sampling_function sets uncond to None when cond_scale is close to 1.

questions.q: Which is the most honest account of why CFG works so well?
options: It is proven to sample the sharpened posterior
It is empirically good, and its theory is still being worked out
It is a form of quantization
questions.answer: It is empirically good, and its theory is still being worked out
questions.why: The motivation is heuristic, and recent papers offer partial explanations rather than a settled answer.
